I purchased this mask to help repair my skin barrier, provide deep hydration, and soothe some extremely irritated areas around my nose and smile lines. The irritation had become so severe that my skin was peeling, cracking, and even bleeding at times. As a Black woman, finding skincare that works well for my skin without causing irritation or hyperpigmentation can be challenging. This mask was an absolute lifesaver. I used it every other day until I finished the box, and the results were incredible. The discomfort is gone, my skin feels soft and hydrated, and the redness has decreased dramatically. The improvement has been significant, and I am genuinely grateful for how well this product worked for me. It was also very easy to apply, stayed in place throughout use, and contains no fragrance....which I greatly appreciate since my skin can be sensitive. Most importantly, the hydration is amazing. My skin felt plump, nourished, and comfortable after every use. I will absolutely be purchasing these again. Highly recommended for anyone dealing with irritation, dryness, or a compromised skin barrier.

I love these masks! Beautiful results after even just an hour of wear (max I’ve worn one is 3 hrs). My face looks and feels plumped, smooth, and glowy after each use. The effects seem to last a day or so, which is well worth the cost of each mask, especially with the sale price of $13 for 4 masks. Easy to apply with minimal slippage. Feels very cooling and refreshing to wear. I am a fan of the VT Cosmetics brand, particularly the PDRN line, and am glad I gave these a try. I subscribed to them and look forward to each use. Try applying a spicule serum before applying the mask to enhance absorption of its ingredients (this is the only VT hydrogel mask that doesn’t come with spicule serum).

Great mask! It is a thick gel like mask that fits my face nicely. It is not ooozing with serum, it feels like it is within the mask. These are very similar to the Peach and Lily Glass Skin gel masks if you’ve tried those. This mask has an instant cooling effect as soon as you apply which is great. The longer you leave on the more plump and hydrating your skin feels. This plumping effect lasts more than 24 hours in my opinion. Would absolutely purchase these again 💜✌🏻

i freaking love this. my skin was GLOWING after using this! it wasn't the easiest to use though. it kept sliding off my face just by a little bit but that was enough to have a small gap between the two parts which i did not love. the gel material was also very easy to break, it would split just from my fingers but it didn't affect the mask overall. would recommend

Very hydrating masks! The fit of the mask isn't the best. On me, it's too long but also too narrow for my face. The holes do line up but I had to cut and make slits in the mask (you can kind of see it in the photo) to make it fit better. This is pretty typical for me though, most masks aren't a great fit and need adjustments. That being said, the hydrogel mask comes into two parts and stays on very well. I was able to go about my day and do some light chores and make breakfast and didn't experience much of any sliding or lifting. It feels cooling and soothing as it's on and it surprisingly doesn't have a lot of essence in the pouch for how hydrating it is. The little bit of essence that is in the pouch has a light blue hue and was enough for me to spread on my neck and chest. I left the mask on for 45 mins, although it states that you can leave this on for 2 - 3 hours. I personally don't have that kind of time but I imagine it would be even more plumping.
Absolutely adore these masks ! They feel amazing and soothing on the face ! Super delicious feeling afterwards, plump skin! Soft and hydrated!

avis.titre: Refreshing, soothing and so comfortable to wear
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this hydrogel mask! It feels cooling right from the moment you put it on, and it stays in place without slipping. After 20 minutes my skin looked plump, fresh, and super hydrated — like I had a mini spa treatment at home. Perfect for tired skin days or before makeup when you want extra glow.

avis.titre: Ehh, it’s ok, too time consuming for a routine
avis.texte: Either my face isn’t asymmetrical or I don’t have a one size fits all face. The mask is pretty slimy (obviously) but I wasn’t sure which was the correct side. It is thick so I like that but trying to adjust it while on, it did tear. I had to cut a few pieces because there were definitely a few gaps. I can’t imagine sleeping with it as it would def come off or get all over the pillow. Kept it on for several hours and I didn’t notice a change but it didn’t leave my face sticky, it felt good and wasn’t really noticeable in the fact it didn’t slide or fall off while doing things (after I made small cuts in it to be flush). There wasn’t much “residue” to rub in per the instructions after removal but my face didn’t feel like I needed to wash it. It didn’t help with redness, or dryness as I felt both were the same if not a bit more than normal in the following days. Not necessarily from the mask. Personally, I don’t notice much of a difference with skin care products to begin with so I think they’re all over priced, especially if they’re one time use. I also can’t actually believe I posted these but here we are.
